    trim(city)

    country AS short_country,
    

CASE country

    WHEN 'CO' THEN 'Colombia'

    WHEN 'CL' THEN 'Chile'
    WHEN 'UY' THEN 'Uruguay'
    WHEN 'BR' THEN 'Brazil'

WITH all_currencies AS (

    SELECT currency

    FROM "qversity"."silver"."stg_loans"

    SELECT currency
    FROM "qversity"."public_silver"."stg_credit_info"

    UNION

    SELECT currency
    FROM "qversity"."silver"."stg_accounts"

),

cleaned AS (

    SELECT DISTINCT
        upper(trim(currency)) AS currency
    FROM all_currencies
    WHERE currency IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT

CASE UPPER(TRIM(currency))

    WHEN 'PEN' THEN 'PE'

    WHEN 'MXN' THEN 'MX'

    ELSE 'OTHER'

END

 AS currency_from_country

FROM cleaned
